text: The selected LSOA, Kingston upon Hull 030C, has a moderate GeoSensitivity of about -1.51, ranking 14th of 168, indicating comparative geographical influence but not causation. Its spatial pattern is classified as a statistically significant High–High cluster with local Moran’s I 0.30 (p = 0.024). Latitude and longitude effects are small (-0.043 and 0.32). The model’s Geo branch explanations are stable and faithful, though pattern scale is not established.
